name: exostosin glycosyltransferase 1

function.text: EXT1 encodes exostosin-1. Annotated molecular activities include acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity and glucuronosyltransferase activity. It participates in ossification and glycosaminoglycan biosynthetic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to exostoses, multiple, type 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Chondrosarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
